name: Ensure Original Nutrition Shake (Vanilla)
whyItWorks: Readily accessible oral nutritional supplement providing 220 calories, 9g protein, and essential micronutrients with minimal residue. Tested suitable for lactose intolerance (<0.5g lactose) and free of raw seeds or harsh insoluble fibers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve chilled from the fridge. Drink in small sips rather than chugging to prevent osmotic fluid shifts in the small bowel.
